{{Money|5}} on death (Default) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Burn}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Split''', internally called '''Hex Corpse Upper''', is an enemy summoned by the [[Splitter]] upon its death. Normally when summoned, it is instead called ''Upper Body''. The only way for its display name to be seen is by summoning it in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It is faster than the [[Splitter]] and has as much health as it does upon healing itself. The '''Split''' has the [[Burn Immunity]] ==Appearance== The '''Split''' is the upper half of the [[Splitter]]'s body. It has brown skin with a brown shirt. Its face is covered with multiple, large teeth. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |62.5 |- !Wave !Health |- |14 |1,313 |- |15 |1,375 |- |16 |1,438 |- |17 |1,500 |- |18 |1,563 |- |19 |1,625 |- |20 |1,688 |- |21 |1,750 |- |22 |1,813 |- |23 |1,875 |- |24 |1,938 |- |25 |2,000 |} ==Strategy== *Multiple high DPS towers, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] are recommended to take down the '''Split'''. *Support towers like the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the DPS of your towers. *As this enemy is quite fast, slowing towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Freezer]] can be very useful against this. **Multiple such towers can also be used to drop its defense. *As it has the [[Burn Immunity]], it cannot be set on fire, also making it immune to having its defense reduced through burn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1HexCorpseUpperBody.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHexCorpseUpperBody.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} HexCorpseUpperIconIG.png|'''Split''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *It is named "''[[Hex Corpse|Hex Corpse's Lower Body]]'s Upper Body''" in-game when summoned by a [[Splitter]], rather than "''[[Splitter]]'s Split''". **This is due to an oversight where the names applied to both of these enemies upon the death of a [[Splitter]] have not been changed. ==Update History== *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **'''Split''' added. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 800 to 1,250 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland II]]
